mechanismOfAction.summary: Semax-derived ACTH(4-7) analog; presumed BDNF/melanocortin nootropic.
mechanismOfAction.description: Poorly documented Semax derivative (variant of Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro, likely acetylated/adamantyl-modified). Mechanism inferred from the Semax parent — BDNF upregulation and melanocortin-pathway signalling. No independent pharmacology published.
